26:221: Ad awen mleɣ anwi iɣef d ţrusun ccwaṭen?
26:225: Day ur twalaḍ ara, ar nitni, di yal taɣzut ţmenṭaṛen?
26:227: Kkes ed wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id ismektayen aṭas Ṛebbi, i irebḥen mbaɛd ma ţwadensen. Ad ẓṛen, wid idensen, tama anida ara ţţin.
27:1: Ṭs. Atnan issekniyen n Leqwṛan, akked Tezmamt iţbegginen.
27:2: D nnhaya u d abecceṛ i lmumnin:
27:3: wid ibedden i tẓallit, iţţaken zzakat, iţţutebbten ɣef laxeṛt nnsen.
27:4: Ih, wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, Ncebbeḥ asen igiten nnsen, dɣa ddebdeben.
27:5: Widak, fellasen aɛaqeb ucmit maḍi. Di laxeṛt, d nitni ara ixesṛen ugwar.
27:6: S tideţ, kečč iusa k id Leqwṛan, sɣuṛ Bab n ṣṣwab, Amusnaw.
27:7: Mi inna Musa i twacult is: "nek walaɣ times, ad awen d awiɣ, segs, asali, neɣ ad awen d awiɣ asafu iṛeqqen, amar a ţţesseḥmum".
27:8: Mi ibbweḍ ɣuṛes, iţwanced: "ad iṛqu wayen illan di tmes, akked wayen i as d izzin. Gedha s Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen!
27:9: A Musa! Ih, Nek d Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
27:10: Veggeṛ taɛkwazt ik"! Mi ţ iwala la tesseḥṛiṭiw, amzun d azrem, ibren, ur iwexxeṛ. "A Musa! Ur ţţagwad! Ar ɣuṛI, ih, ur ţţagwaden imazanen,
27:11: siwa win idensen, sinna, iuɣal iwqem, deffir tuccḍa. Nek, s tideţ, Psemmiḥeɣ, Pḥunnuɣ.
27:12: Ger afus ik di loib ik, a d iffeɣ d amellal, ur ihlik. Si tza issekniyen, i Ferɛun akked ugdud is. Nitni, war ccekk, d agdud icemten".
27:13: Mi ten id usan issekniyen nneɣ, ɛinani, nnan: "wagi iban d ssḥur".
27:14: Ugin ten s ddens d ţnefxa, u, deg iman nnsen, ţţutebbten. Wali, ihi, amek teḍṛa d ifessaden.
27:15: Niɣ Nefka tamusni i Dawed akked Sliman. Nnan: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, i aɣ Ismenyafen i waṭaṣ n yimdanen iumnen".
27:16: Sliman iwṛet Dawed, u inna: "a yimdanen! Neţwaselmed tutlayt n yifṛax; iţţunefk aɣ si yal cci. Ayagi, s tideţ, ard lfeḍl n ṣṣeḥ".
27:17: Pwajemmlen d, i Sliman, iɛsekṛiwen is si leonun, imdanen, ifṛax. Mdarraren.
27:18: Armi, mi bbwḍen ar teɣzut n tweḍfin, tenna d tweṭuft: "a yaweṭṭuf, kecmemt ar ixxamen nnkwent, mulac, war ccekk, a kwent iẓd Sliman, neţţa akked iɛsekṛiwen is, ur faqen".
27:19: Icmumeḥ, iḍṣa, ɣef wayen d tenna. Inna: "a Mass iw! Err iyi ad snemmreɣ lɣit iK, is i ɣ Tɣateḍ, nek akked imawlan iw; ad xedmeɣ iseɣ ara Tṛaḍiḍ; Ssekcem iyi, s uḥunu K, ar imdanen iK imaɛnen".
27:20: Issefqed ifṛax, inna: "acimi ur walaɣ ara iččibib, day d lɣayeb?
27:21: War ccekk, ad sɛaddiɣ fellas aɛaqeb uqsiḥ, neɣ a t zluɣ, neɣ a d iawi tasebbiwt tubrizt".
27:22: Ur iɛaṭṭel ara. Inna d: "fehmeɣ ayen ur tefhimeḍ. Usiɣ d ɣuṛek si Saba, s usali unṣiḥ.
27:23: Ih, ufiɣ en tameṭṭut d tagelliṭ nnsen. Iţţunefk as si yal cci. ɣuṛes asgeld abarar.
27:24: Ufiɣ ţ in, neţţat akked ugdud is, la kennun i yiṭij, war Ṛebbi. Cciṭan icebbeḥ asen igiten nnsen. Iḍeṛf iten seg ubrid, dɣa nitni ur ţwanhan.
27:25: Acimi ur knan ara i Ṛebbi, id Issufuɣen lesrar, di tmurt akked igenwan, i Iẓṛan ayen teţţeffrem u ayen d teţberriḥem?
27:26: Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Mass n usgeld ameqwṛaḥan".
27:27: Inna: "a nẓeṛ ma tessawleḍ d tideţ, neɣ ma kečč seg ikeddaben.
27:28: Ṛuḥ s tebṛaţ iw agi, ḍeggeṛ asen ţ, sinna, wexxeṛ asen, wali acu ara d rren".
27:29: Tenna: "a yimḍebbṛen, teţwaḍeggeṛ iyi d tebṛaţ tukyist.
27:30: Ih, sɣuṛ Sliman. Aţan: s yisem n Ṛebbi Aḥnin Iţḥunun.
27:31: Ur ssemɣwaṛet ara iman nnwen ɣuṛi, aset ed ɣuṛi, d imḍuɛen".
27:32: Tenna: "a yimḍebbṛen, fket ed ṛṛay nnwen af lameṛ iw. Ur ţseyyiɣ lameṛ, siwa garawen".
27:33: Nnan: "nekwni d imawlan n tezmert, nesɛa lemḥella tuqsiḥt. Lameṛ i kem. Muqel d acu ara d tseyyiḍ".
27:34: Tenna: "s tideţ, igeldan ssefsaden tamdint ara kecmen. Sdullun imdanen is lɛali. Akka ay xeddmen.
27:35: Nek, ad asen azneɣ tarzeft, ad aṛouɣ acu ara d awin imcegɛan".
27:36: Mi tebbweḍ ar Sliman, inna: "day ad iyi tɛawnem s terkunt? Ayen i yi Ifka Ṛebbi, yif ayen i wen Ifka. D kunwi kan i ifeṛḥen, s terzeft nnwen.
27:37: Uɣal ɣuṛsen. Ih, a nṛuḥ ɣuṛsen s lɛaskeṛ, iwumi ur zmiren. A ten id nessuffeɣ, syenna, ndellen, d imejṭuḥen".
27:38: Inna: "a yimḍebbṛen, anwa degwen, ara yi d iawin asgeld is, uqbel a yi d asen d imḍuɛen"?
27:39: Aɛfrit si leonun, inna d: "ad ak t id awiɣ, uqbel ma tekkreḍ seg umekkan ik. I wayagi, war ccekk, nek d uzmir muman".
27:40: Inna d bab n tmusni si Tezmamt: "nek ad ak t id awiɣ, uqbel a ţfukkeḍ asmeṛmec". Mi t iwala irs ed ɣuṛes, inna: "wagi si lfeḍl n Mass iw, ad iyi ijeṛṛeb ma ad snemmreɣ, neɣ ma ad jehleɣ. Win isnemmren, isnemmer kan i iman is. Win ijehl, ihi, Mass iw d Asɛay, d Ukyis".
27:41: Inna: "bedlet as udem usgeld is, a nẓeṛ ma teţwanha, neɣ haaţ seg wid ur neţwanha".
27:42: Mi d tusa, nnan as: "day am wagi, usgeld inem"? Terra d: "amzun d neţţa". "Tusa yaɣ d tmusni, uqbel neţţat, nuzen.
27:43: Isṛuḥ iţ wayen tunez, war Ṛebbi. Tella, s tideţ, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
27:44: Nnan as: "ekcem ar lbeṛo"! Mi t twala, tɣil degs aman; tesban ed ifadden is. Inna: "s tideţ, d lbeṛo ulelluc imzin". Tenna: "a Mass iw! Ih, denseɣ iman iw. Akked Sliman, unzeɣ aS i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen".
27:45: Niɣ Nuzen ed, i Tamud, gmat sen Ṣaliḥ: "ɛabdet Ṛebbi"! Maca, rran snat n trebbuyaɣ, ţţemnamarent.
27:46: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acimi teţɣawalem ar tucmiţ, uqbel iseɣ? Lemmer a ţţesteɣfṛem Ṛebbi, ahat aḥunu fellawen".
27:47: Nnan: "tkeḥḥeseḍ aɣ, kečč akked wi iddan yidek". Inna: "lfal nnwen ar Ṛebbi, u kunwi d agdud ara iţţuhewwlen".
27:48: Llan, di temdint, tza iterrasen i issefsaden di tmurt, ur ţleqqimen.
27:49: Nnan: "yyaw a nemmesgal s Ṛebbi, ard a neẓḍem deg iḍ fellas, neţţa akked twacult is. Sinna, a nini i bab is: ur nelli d inagan n tmenɣiwt n tawacult is. Ih, nekwni, d imawlan n tideţ".
27:50: Undin ticeṛkeţ, Nundi ticeṛkeţ, nitni ur faqen.
27:51: Wali amek teḍṛa di tceṛkeţ nnsen. Nenɣed iten, nitni, akked ugdud nnsen, meṛṛa.
27:52: Atnan hudden ixxamen nnsen, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Deg wayagi, war ccekk, assekni i ugdud issnen.
27:54: I Luṭ, mi inna i ugdud is: "teţţeddum ar wayen n dir, u kunwi teţwalim.
27:55: Ih, kunwi teţţeddum ar irgazen, tebɣam ten, war tilawin. Ih, kunwi d agdud ur nessin".
